title: Intelligence Skill Creator Input Schema
description: Create new SmartAIHub skills from scratch, or iteratively improve existing ones

enumDescriptions.create: Create a brand-new skill with full schemas, code, and tests
enumDescriptions.improve: Iteratively improve an existing skill via LLM + research
enumDescriptions.convert_workflow: Convert a Virtual Workflow JSON to a complete skill

description.description: What the new skill should do (required for create mode)
examples: A skill that converts Thai dates to Buddhist Era format
A skill that extracts structured product info from unstructured text
A skill that generates SEO-optimized meta tags from a page title and content

skill_language.description: Programming language for the skill implementation

enumDescriptions.python: Python — best for math, NLP, data processing, algorithms
enumDescriptions.javascript: JavaScript/Node.js — best for async ops, JSON transformation, templating
enumDescriptions.auto: Let ISC choose the best language automatically

complexity.description: Expected skill complexity — influences depth of planning and code generation

enumDescriptions.complex: Multi-step pipeline, advanced algorithms, rich output

skill_name.description: For create: optional slug override (auto-generated if blank). For improve: required existing skill name. Must be kebab-case or snake_case (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores).

rounds.description: Number of improve iterations (improve mode only)

ask_user.description: Pause and ask user for clarification when uncertain (improve mode only)

allow_test_expansion.description: Allow ISC to add new test cases during improvement (improve mode only)

workflow_json.description: Virtual Workflow JSON exported from the Workflow Editor (required for convert_workflow mode)

llm_gateway_mode.description: LLM gateway mode: 'system' uses the platform's built-in gateway (credits tracked), 'custom' uses a user-provided API key and base URL

enumDescriptions.system: Use the SmartAIHub system gateway — LLM costs deducted from user credits automatically
enumDescriptions.custom: Provide your own API key and base URL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

llm_model_search.description: Model ID selected from the system model list (used when llm_gateway_mode = system)

llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (used when llm_gateway_mode = custom; leave blank to use environment default)

llm_model.description: Model to use for code and schema generation

llm.description: Nested LLM config (alternative to llm_* flat fields, for CLI/API use)

research_max_topics.description: Max web research topics per improve round

research_max_results.description: Max search results per research topic

research_max_snippet_chars.description: Max characters of research content per LLM prompt

safety_restrict_paths.description: Restrict generated patches to the skill's own directory

safety_disallow_new_deps.description: Disallow adding new external dependencies during improvement

safety_require_signature.description: Enforce that respond() signature remains intact during improvement

skill_name.description: Required in improve mode — the slug of the existing skill to improve.

description.description: Required in create mode — natural language description of what the new skill should do.

examples.description: A skill that converts Thai dates between Buddhist Era (BE) and Common Era (CE) formats, supporting multiple date string formats
A skill that extracts structured product data (name, price, features, pros, cons) from unstructured product description text using NLP techniques
A skill that generates a professional weekly schedule in multiple formats (JSON, Markdown table, plain text) given a list of tasks with priorities and time estimates
